answer: The echo report reveals the merge explicitly at each jade. Each collapsed cluster gets one fable weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, someone who spins up 204 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 144 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3526 identities would post 4790 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
